update_rationale: WS3.1a freezes lifecycle scenario applicability and the 13 capability-level gaps before introducing shared drivers

interruption_prior_turn_isolation.contract: An interrupted or empty current turn never rewrites a prior turn's assistant history.

recorder_transient_cleanup.contract: Cancellation or close balances recorder cursors and purges per-run transient bookkeeping.

stream_close_cleanup.contract: Closing the bridge stream closes the innermost SDK iterator and stops its running work.

tool_inflight_cancellation_drain.contract: Cancellation with tool work in flight obeys delivered-text commit policy and drains the tool boundary.

unknown_event_tolerance.contract: A malformed or unknown provider event does not suppress a later valid terminal response.

after_each_applicable_scenario.reset_isolation: reset() clears state introduced by the scenario
after_each_applicable_scenario.snapshot_json_safe: snapshot_state() remains JSON-serializable after the scenario

stream_close_cleanup.rationale: Workflow-owned async iterators must receive consumer close.

tool_inflight_cancellation_drain.rationale: Deep workflows can expose recorder tool phases and cooperative cancellation.

unknown_event_tolerance.rationale: GenericWorkflowBridge consumes user return values, not an open-ended provider event taxonomy.

unknown_event_tolerance.rationale: astream_events is open-ended and may add malformed or unknown event objects.
